Project.newTitle: Give the system a useful raw idea—not a perfect spec.
Project.newDesc: Drop an idea with rough boundaries. The analyzer will identify what is known, what is missing, and what requires confirmation.

NewProject.caption: Chapter 01 · capture intent
NewProject.title: Give the system a useful raw idea—not a perfect spec.
NewProject.subtitle: Describe the users, the core job, important features, and known constraints. Missing high-impact decisions become focused clarification questions later.
NewProject.projectIdeaPlaceholder: Who is this for? What must they be able to do? What business or technical constraints are already known?
NewProject.projectIdeaNote: Do not paste API keys or other secrets. This text becomes long-lived project context.
NewProject.refineNote: You can refine context before final generation.
NewProject.nextStep1: Analyze the raw idea and expose requirement gaps.
NewProject.nextStep2: Ask only the clarification questions that affect implementation.
NewProject.nextStep3: Normalize confirmed decisions into canonical project context.
NewProject.nextStep4: Plan and generate the right documentation depth.
NewProject.nextStep5: Resolve relevant skills and build a dependency-aware backlog.
NewProject.nextStep6: Review the Markdown and export a secret-safe ZIP.
NewProject.prerequisiteDesc: A valid provider session is required before AI analysis. You can create this draft now and configure the key separately.

ProviderDesk.caption: BYOK checkpoint
ProviderDesk.title: Wire the model without leaking the key.
ProviderDesk.subtitle: This screen only configures the current server session. Provider secrets do not belong in generated Markdown, browser-visible errors, fixtures, telemetry, or ZIP exports.
ProviderDesk.aiProviderDesc: Choose a provider, confirm the model ID, and test the connection before running analysis or document generation.
ProviderDesk.securityNoteDesc: Responses expose safe provider/model metadata only. If a provider rejects the key, the UI shows an actionable typed failure without printing the raw SDK payload.
